_comment: Models from Kenney's starter kits (MIT licence, github.com/KenneyNL). Units: Kenney's are metres; a GTA2 block is about 2 m, so scale 0.5 puts them in blocks.

cars._comment: by_model: the vehicle's model number (CARI order) -> model name; by_sprite: car sprite number -> model name. Vehicles named by neither are built from their own sprite at run time (dll/src/car_bodies.cpp). See tools/import_assets.py.

_comment2: Street props and plants from Poly Haven (CC0), 1k textures downscaled to 512.
